---
description: "Use when the task is review-oriented. Prioritize bugs, regressions, edge cases, and missing verification over summaries."
---

# Review Mode

- Treat review requests as bug-finding and risk-finding tasks first.
- Lead with concrete findings, not implementation praise.
- Prioritize behavioral regressions, broken edge cases, data-flow mistakes, and incorrect framework usage.
- Call out missing verification when the changed surface is large or high-risk.
- Keep summaries brief after findings.
